description: This file contains PHP functions related to displaying and managing line items within the AOS_Products_Quotes module of SuiteCRM. It includes functions for rendering line items in different views (EditView, DetailView), managing groupings, formatting numeric values, and handling tax and discount display logic.

methods.name: display_lines
methods.description: Generates HTML for displaying line items in the specified view ('EditView' or 'DetailView'), including handling of groups, products, services, and their respective details.

methods.name: display_shipping_vat
methods.description: Generates HTML for editing or viewing shipping tax and VAT fields based on the view context.

methods.name: display_tax_detail_view
methods.description: Formats the tax value for display in the detail view with appropriate percentage symbol and formatting.

methods.name: stripDecimalPointsAndTrailingZeroes
methods.description: Removes trailing decimal zeros and decimal separator from a number string if only zeros follow the decimal point.

methods.name: get_discount_string
methods.description: Returns formatted discount percentage or amount based on the given type and locale.
